{{RaceIcon|Ogre}} [[Ogre]] | status = Active }} The '''Bilgerats''' are a pirate crew from [[Plunder Isle]] that were led by Captain [[Barbaros]]. They met an ill fate when Barbaros led his crew to the accursed island of [[Balor]] in search of treasure aboard ''[[The Rat's Nest]]'', having stolen age-old secrets from [[Falrevere]]. Although they established [[Bilgerat Compound|a compound]] on one of the northern islands of Balor, Captain Barbaros and several of his men were ambushed by orcs of the [[Stormreaver clan]] and dragged to [[Stormwrought Castle]].[[Logbook of The Rat's Nest]] [[Second Mate O'Donovan]] and [[Jade]] returned to the compound, where they planned to return to the castle to free Barbaros and the rest of the party, but by that point Barbaros had already been used to house the soul of [[Deathlord Tidebane]][https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1462715515360378940 Moriena from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] - "He's Deathlord Tidebane" and the rest of the captured pirates were experimented on by the [[Shadow Council]] and turned into oozes. ==Members== * {{NPC||Barbaros||Captain Barbaros|icon=Human Male}}† * {{NPC||Second Mate O'Donovan|icon=Human Female}} * {{NPC||Outlook Goro|icon=Ogre}} * {{NPC||Cook Snickerfang|icon=Gnoll}} * [[Moralis]]† * [[Framwin]]† * [[Jade]] ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Pirates]]
